notes: Three pieces of the Control Panel were rendering in fonts the design system never chose, because form controls do not inherit type from the page. The minimise and close buttons were in Arial. The debug roles table was in a generic…

Fixed the cause rather than the three symptoms: buttons, inputs, selects and textareas now inherit type, so the next control anyone adds is correct by default instead of joining that list. The debug table also had its font hardcoded…
Verified in the running app: Arial gone, generic monospace gone, the browser size gone, and the fields that already had a design-system font kept it.
